release_slices.name: POS online order pairing hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Allow authorized POS staff to confirm or reject incoming online orders without being blocked by missing physical device pairing.
release_slices.purpose: Allow authorized POS staff to confirm or reject incoming online orders without being blocked by missing physical device pairing.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Removed the physical-device pairing middleware from the POS online-order status route while preserving tenant authentication, POS capability enforcement, pos:transact permission, request validation, authenticated user checks, and open-shift/location checks inside the use case. Added route contract coverage and a compliance declaration for the POS route change.
included_features: POS incoming online order confirmation and rejection without physical-device pairing

No frontend bundle or POS UI behavior changes

documentation_closure.rationale: The behavior is already governed by ADR 0031, which says physical-device pairing must not block normal authorized POS order handling. This release keeps the POS route, route contract test, compliance declaration, and reviewed batch manifest together so the emergency hotfix has auditable scope, risk, rollback, and production proof requirements.

release_slices.adr_or_compliance: ADR 0031 already governs this behavior: physical-device pairing is optional compatibility state and must not block normal authorized POS order handling. Compliance declaration 2026-07-03-pos-online-order-pairing-hotfix records the route-level impact.
